framework.purpose: Track event-driven trades through the full lifecycle: entry → catalyst → exit-by-rule. Each event trade is sized to capture a specific catalyst; once the catalyst resolves, the position must be exited or converted to thematic-core sizing per the pre-committed rule.

default_exit_rules_for_event_trades.if_beat_+5_to_10pct_AH: Trim 50% into gap-up (within 24h). Hold remainder as runner for 5–7 days.
default_exit_rules_for_event_trades.if_beat_+10pct_plus: Trim 60–70% into gap-up. Hold small lottery-ticket runner.
default_exit_rules_for_event_trades.if_inline_or_chop: Hold 24–48h. If no follow-through by next session, exit full or trim to thematic core size.
default_exit_rules_for_event_trades.if_miss_-10pct_plus: Full exit immediately, accept the loss.

framework.key_lesson: Recoil/IV-crush is real. Stocks that gap +8%+ on prints fade ~30–50% of the gap within a week on average. Event trades must trim into the gap; do NOT apply 'don't sell winners on confirmation' logic — that's for thematic positions only.

concentration_catalyst_trades._comment: Concentration overlays sit on TOP of thematic_core. Often breach single-name caps deliberately for a specific catalyst.
concentration_catalyst_trades.thesis_at_entry: Why concentration is warranted for this specific catalyst.
concentration_catalyst_trades.framework_violation_note: DELIBERATE: position weight breaches single-name cap by Xpp. Accepted by user as catalyst-specific overlay. Reverts post-print via mechanical exits.

scenario_A_blowout.trigger: Beat + Q?+1 guide ≥ bull threshold + thesis-confirming commentary + gap +10%+
scenario_A_blowout.action: Trim X sh into gap-up T+1 open. Lock €Y into cash. Position N → N-X sh.
scenario_A_blowout.rationale: Lock the catalyst gain. Remaining sh preserve thematic_core exposure.

scenario_B_clean_beat_inline_guide.trigger: Beat + Q?+1 guide in-line + AH chop ±5%
scenario_B_clean_beat_inline_guide.action: Trim smaller % within 48h on any post-print stabilization.
scenario_B_clean_beat_inline_guide.rationale: Sell-the-news pattern likely. Modest trim respects bar-too-high tape without abandoning thesis.

scenario_C_inline_chop.trigger: In-line beat + Q?+1 flat + AH chop / commentary neutral
scenario_C_inline_chop.action: Trim larger %, move proceeds to cash, hold core and reassess thesis.

scenario_D_miss_soft_guide.trigger: Miss revenue/EPS + Q?+1 guide soft + thesis-break commentary
scenario_D_miss_soft_guide.action: EXIT majority of catalyst tranche next-day open. Position N → original core size.

scenario_E_disaster_cycle_peak.trigger: Big miss + soft Q?+1 + cycle-peak language
scenario_E_disaster_cycle_peak.action: EXIT full catalyst tranche immediately. Reassess core position within 5 sessions.

pre_print_trim_triggers_live.trigger_action_1: Trim N sh into upside continuation. Locks ~€Z.
